pages.title: Horned Crocodile
pages.text: $(o)Voay$() ($(o)Voay robustus$()), the horned crocodile, lived in the rivers and marshes of Madagascar.$(br2)It was a heavy, robust crocodile with small bony horns at the back of its skull, and was the island's largest predator.$(br2)It died out within the last few thousand years, after people reached Madagascar.
